about: The Canvas test project the cloud check may write to (src/CueCheck.gs, tools/check.mjs). project_id stays empty until Kiko's CUE TEST project exists in Canvas; Check Cue refuses to run until then. The project's event date must be in the past, so Canvas never sends its FSAs on its own. Its crew: One (email alias, registered with crew sign-in), Two (email alias, not registered), Three (no email).
